object_description: six-storey volume set back from the street with large glazed facades and an open stance
design_condition: the volume continues the pearl-like arrangement of buildings along the street but is set back to create a public entrance space shared with the neighbouring tower, forming a new urban composition

positive: The pearl-like arrangement of building volumes along the street is continued
Setting the structure back creates a public entrance space for both the school and the tower
The positioning and volume create a new urban composition with the neighbouring buildings
Water basin, plant borders and a covered vestibule create an appealing entrance situation
The structure stands out architecturally thanks to its open stance and lightness
The large glazed facades provide a counterpoint and document openness and transparency
The functionality of the building is impressive
The public ground floor and the media library floor above are organised functionally
The spacious transparent foyer with two-storey spatial figures connects the two public floors into a unit
This provides good orientation and clarity
The four-flight central staircase connects all floors and creates an open communication zone
The classrooms are clearly structured, flexibly usable and have well-dimensioned, well-lit access zones
The learning islands are correctly arranged and well dimensioned
Their partial two-storey design creates interior connections and interesting spatial structures
The laboratories are sufficiently lit via the sunken inner courtyard
Deliveries and bicycle access are planned via the north-facing recess in the terrain
The load-bearing system with wall panels, facade supports and a central core gives a high degree of flexibility
The volume is compact with average facade development
Expected construction costs are in line with the specification and in the lower segment
The project impresses with its high functionality and structure
The circulation, spatial divisions and formations result in an exciting interior
The load-bearing system enables a high degree of flexibility and cost-effectiveness
negative: The quality of the new situation is diminished by the proximity of the six-storey building to the tower block
Whether the open, transparent stance is justifiable in this constricted situation is questionable
The recycled concrete and prefabricated columns give a consistent but rather cool interior atmosphere
The proportion of glass is relatively high
